home_subtitle: Section 1 词汇精讲上 · look 家族
part1_desc: 第 1–27 步：翻译帮讲 look 家族五个短语，教材帮讲 die out、intelligent、talented 和 field；读《苏文查资料》，练习帮做题过关。
part2_desc: 第 28–50 步：读《李博士的实验室》，独立验证 look 家族和本课词汇；写作帮学写“查资料”小段。
note: 本课阅读材料为教研自编，非课本原文。考查能力：look through/look up/look for/look after/look at 的区分、die out、intelligent、talented、in the field of 与 field 作场地。Unit 1 Look it up! 主题，核心词 intelligent/talented/field，短语 die out/look through/look up/look for/look after/look at。

steps.title: 广播站新任务：查资料
steps.teach_html:
广播站的新任务来了：站长苏文要做一期“查资料”节目。查资料要会用工具书：翻一翻百科全书，查一查词典，找一找丢的东西，照顾一下家里的小弟弟。

这一课就讲查资料的五个 look 短语，外加三个词：die out（灭绝）、intelligent（聪明的）、talented（有才华的），还有一个多义词 field（领域；场地）。

steps.title: 翻译帮：look through 快速查看
steps.teach_html:
look through 快速查看；浏览；翻阅。后接书、报纸、名单这类可以翻的东西。

Every morning, Su Wen looks through the new books in the library. 苏文每天早上快速翻看图书馆的新书。

记住这个画面：look through 是翻一遍，不是一个字一个字地读。想找答案，先翻一遍再细读。

steps.title: 教材帮：look up / look for / look after / look at
steps.teach_html:
四个 look 短语，分工不一样：

look up 查阅：在词典、参考书里查。We look up new words in a dictionary. 我们在词典里查生词。

look for 寻找：丢了东西找。I look for my notebook everywhere. 我到处找我的笔记本。

look after 照顾；照看。Su Wen looks after her little brother. 苏文照顾她的小弟弟。

look at 看。Look at the picture. 看这张图片。

顺带认一认，不展开考：look over 查看；检查；look around 环顾；look forward to 盼望；期待；look out 当心。

steps.title: 教材帮：die out 灭绝
steps.teach_html:
die out 灭绝；绝种。是不及物动词短语，后面不接宾语。

Dinosaurs died out about 66 million years ago. 恐龙大约在 6600 万年前灭绝。

die 的现在分词是 dying。顺带记：die of/from... 死于……；die down 逐渐变弱；逐渐平息；die for... 为……献出生命。

steps.title: 教材帮：intelligent 聪明的
steps.teach_html:
intelligent /ɪnˈtelɪdʒənt/ adj. 有才智的；聪明的。说的是脑子好使、学东西快。

Reading helps us become more knowledgeable and more intelligent. 阅读帮助我们变得更博学、更聪明。

它的名词是 intelligence 才智；智慧：John showed high intelligence from an early age. 约翰从小就显出高智商。

steps.title: 教材帮：talented 有才华的
steps.teach_html:
talented /ˈtæləntɪd/ adj. 有才华的；天才的。由 talent（n. 才能；天赋）+ -ed 构成。

be talented in 在……方面有天赋，相当于 have a gift for：She is talented in drawing. 她在绘画方面有天赋。比较级是 more talented。

顺带记构词：名词后缀 -ist、-ian 加在词尾表示人，u1r1 讲过 science→scientist（科学家）、music→musician（音乐家）、art→artist（艺术家）。新例子：dentist（牙科医生）、physicist（物理学家）。

steps.title: 教材帮：field 领域；场地
steps.teach_html:
field /fiːld/ n. 有两个常用意思：

（1）领域：in the field of 在……领域。He is a leader in the field of education. 他是教育领域的领军人物。Leonardo da Vinci was talented in many different fields. 达·芬奇在许多不同领域都有天赋。

（2）场地；田地（可数名词）：Our school needs a new football field. 我们学校需要一个新的足球场。The children are playing in a field near the river. 孩子们在河边的一块田野里玩。

判断用哪个意思，看后面跟的是“学科、行业”还是“实实在在的一块地”。

steps.title: 翻译帮：查资料三步法
steps.teach_html:
查资料别从第一页读到最后一页，三步就够：

First, think about what you want to know. 先想好你要查什么。

Then, look it up. 再去查。词是按字母顺序排的（in alphabetical order），想查恐龙就去找 D。

You can look through the book and read only the entry you need. 快速翻一遍，只读你需要的那一条。

steps.title: 教材帮：易混点总汇
steps.teach_html:
上题之前，先把容易混的四组分清楚：

look up 查阅（查词）— look for 寻找（找东西）；look after 照顾（照顾人）— look at 看（看东西）。

die out 灭绝，后面不接宾语；die 只是“死”。

intelligent 聪明（脑子好使）— talented 有才华（在某方面有本事）。一个人可以又聪明又有才华，两个词说的不是一回事。

steps.title: 翻译帮：阅读材料——苏文查资料
steps.teach_html:
下面是一段自编短文，讲苏文怎么查资料。读两遍，找一找：五个 look 短语各出现在哪里？达·芬奇为什么又聪明又有才华？

读的时候用扫描的方法：先看问题，再到文章里找答案。

steps.title: 练习帮：look through 是什么意思
steps.scene: 苏文每天翻看新书，她在做什么？
steps.stem: What does “look through” mean?
options: find a word in a dictionary
steps.help: through 有“从头到尾翻一遍”的意思，look through 就是快速翻一遍。
steps.explain: Look through means read something quickly. 苏文每天快速翻看新书，就是 look through。

wrong_feedback.A: look for 是“寻找”，丢了东西才 look for。
wrong_feedback.C: take care of / look after 才是“照顾”。
wrong_feedback.D: 在词典里查词是 look up，不是 look through。

steps.reading: Su Wen is a student at our school radio station. Every week, she looks through a children's encyclopaedia to find new stories. When she does not know a word, she looks it up in a dictionary. When she loses her notebook, she looks for it everywhere. She also looks after her little brother at home and looks at the pictures in the book with him. Last week, she read about dinosaurs. Dinosaurs died out about 66 million years ago, but they were not all the same. Some were as small as chickens. Others were as big as ten elephants. Su Wen thinks Leonardo da Vinci was very intelligent. He was also talented in many different fields: painting, music, science and more. She wants to be an intelligent student too, so she looks through her books every day.

steps.reading: Su Wen is a student at our school radio station. Every week, she looks through a children's encyclopaedia to find new stories. steps.title: 写作帮：怎么写“查资料”小段
steps.teach_html:
写一段“我是怎样查资料的”，三步就够：

先说你要查什么：I want to know about dinosaurs.

再说你用什么工具查：I look up new words in a dictionary and look through the book to find answers.

最后说你查到了什么：I find that dinosaurs died out about 66 million years ago.

范文一句记下来：I look up new words in a dictionary and look through the book to find answers.

wrong_feedback.A: 从第一页读到最后一页太慢了，百科全书是用来查的。
wrong_feedback.B: 猜不是办法，查到的才是真的。
wrong_feedback.C: 翻完每一页又忘了，等于白查。

steps.title: 本课小结
steps.teach_html:
本课收官：look 家族五兄弟分工明确——look through 快速翻看、look up 查阅、look for 寻找、look after 照顾、look at 看；die out 灭绝，后面不接宾语；intelligent 聪明、talented 有才华；field 既是“领域”（in the field of），也是“场地、田野”。

下一课讲“出生”和“随着……”：be born、as、perhaps、a type of、be related to、either...or...。站长先卖个关子。

title: 词汇精讲上：look 家族
